balls.text: slower short ball again, Miller tries to give him the charge and muscle it down, but finds long-on. Just no pace to work with
Tewatia shuffles across to try to access the leg side, Stoinis stays slow, short of a length and wide. Pulled down to long-on for one
slower short ball, Miller doesn't manage to time it. Just the single to wide long-on
into the pitch, angling away, punched down the ground

slower ball, short into the pitch, Pandya has to go for everything, and this time he ends up hitting straight to long-on. Looking at how others have gone, this has been a good innings. Only man to hit a six so far
waist-high short ball at 126ks. Pandya is well settled, and he picks the bones out of this. Flat six over midwicket, the longer side of the ground
inside edge to a length ball, goes to long-on, and the mis-hit actually allows them to come back for two, which allows Pandya to keep the strike
a proper bouncer, but a slower one, at 114ks. Miller is defeated again. Successive dots
again the slower short ball, 118ks, beats his attempt to pull. A dot ball in the 19th
slower ball, 113ks, short into the pitch, slapped down to long-off for one
tucks him up with a quick length ball, goes for a leg-bye, which might just be the first extra of the innings
stays wide, and is hit to deep extra cover for one
fired in quick and full, pushed to long-on for one

this is an incredible shot. He has managed to slap a short-of-a-length delivery over long-on for six on this slow pitch. All the power has come from his wrists and forearms. Three sixes so far, all three off Bishnoi
wrong'un, too short, down leg too, and he has gone clean over midwicket for only the second six of the match. Brings up his fifty in 44 balls
a touch short, pulled between deep midwicket and deep square for four. Finally over a run a ball
short of a length, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
full and straight, turned to square leg for a single. Pandya not happy. Could have done more with this
keeps it out of his reach. Stays short of a length. Slapped wide of long-off for two
down the wicket, Avesh goes short of a length and angles it in, edged onto his boot for a single
tucks him up with a length ball, defended back to him
on a length, swinging in, inner half of the bat
goes wide and away from his reach, toe-ended to extra cover
slider, wicket to wicket, a single off the inside half of the bat
a touch short, pulled to deep midwicket for one
a soft leading edge as he looks to work this to leg
on a length, straight, pushed back to him
driven down to long-off for one
on a length, into the pads, put into a hole on the leg side for two

Shankar has to take the risk now. He is 10 off 11. Death overs approaching. So he goes for a slog. Naveen stays on target, on a good length, at 131ks. Shankar misses, Naveen hits. His first IPL wicket
wide yorker, 135ks, squeezes under his bat
on-pace, 131ks, fullish, into the pads, Hardik looks to go over leg, but a front edge to long-on for one
short of a length, 108ks, into the pads, pulled to long leg for one
slower ball, 105ks, into the pitch, pulled to deep square for a single
short of a length, angling in, staying low, kept out by Hardik
slower offcutter, short of a length, 113ks, beats him attempt to pull both with the cut and low bounce. Manages to get a bottom edge, though
short of a length, into the pads, tucked away to deep midwicket
first full delivery of the over, swiped to deep midwicket for one more
short of a length, just outside off, punched down to long-off for one
short of a length, straight, punched down to long-on for a single
no pace in the pitch. Shankar looks to pull him from outside off, but the ball never arrives. Front edge back to him
shuffles across to punch this down to long-off for one
strays down the leg side, and Shankar gets enough bat on it to beat short fine

nearly a run-out. Desperate stuff from GT. Pandya is cramped up again, but Shankar calls him through for a single with the ball still on the pitch. Avesh is quick to field it but misses with a direct hit. Shankar had no chance
looks to cut but again Avesh has cramped him up for room. Ends up bottom-edging it back to Avesh
short of a length, even tighter line, pushed back to him
short of a length, no room, punched hard into the ground, and misfielded at backward point
another slow legbreak. On a length, Pushed down the ground, straight midwicket tries to deny them the single but his slide is not enough
slow flight again, nearly yorks him. Dug out back to him

lures him, teases him, tortures him with a slow high legbreak. Manohar decides he will go for it. But these boundaries are not small. All the power has to be manufactured by the batter. Clearly he hasn't imparted enough of it although it does take a diving catch to his right from Naveen-ul-Haq at deep cover
on a length, slow in the air, punched down to long-off
down the wicket, gets too close to it, drives it along the ground to long-on
slow in the air, on off, has him lunging at it. Pushed straight to extra cover
pushed to long-off for one; 4-0-16-2 for Krunal Pandya
worked into the leg side for one
half a shout for pad first as this one turns only slightly, but he has got bat first on it

second wicket for Krunal. Saha down the wicket early, Pandya pulls his length back, the ball turns too, and Saha ends up hitting it straight to long-on. Seemed to me he decided late to just chip it but timed it too well
down the wicket to push this to long-on for one
on a length, middle and leg, sits in the surface, pushed back to his right
pitched up outside off, driven to long-off for one
pushed through. Slider. Punched uppishly but wide enough of Mishra for one to long-on
down the wicket to chip it over extra cover for two. Not even 79ks
on a length, around off, pushed to deep cover for one
down the wicket, Mishra slows it down, turns it from leg, bunted into the leg side for one
overpitched, slow in the air, but hit straight to extra cover

first six of the match. It always looked like they have decided to take Bishnoi down. He gives this just a hint of flight, and overpitches fairly wide outside off. Hardik goes back down the ground, and clears long-off with ease
down the wicket, beaten in the air, gets an inside edge onto the pad, and Hardik calls him through for a quick single
looks for the big hit down the leg side as this is pitched straighter. Gets only a thick inside edge for one
lovely shot. Hardik showing first signs of getting into his work. Too wide even though the length is good. Hardik deliberately goes in the air and straighter of deep cover
down the wicket to work this to long-on for a single
on a length, wide, driven to deep cover
backs away to create something. This is the second time he has done this successfully. Uses Stoinis's pace to guide this between backward point and short third
looks for the pull, early into the shot as this is the slower ball at 114ks. Hit on the glove as he is through the shot before the ball arrives
shuffles across to push this length ball down to long-on for one
short of a length, hardly room, pushed back to him
looks for the cut shot but the ball is too slow off the surface. Ends up playing it back to Stoinis
short of a length, hip high, pulled into the bigger side of the ground and comes back for two
again a dot as Saha looks for the late-cut. Not enough pace or shortness of length
driven wide of long-off for two after advancing down the wicket
looks for the late-cut, makes room, too, but plays it straight to point because he doesn't have the length to work with
gives him the charge, Krunal goes wider, pushed to deep cover for one
another dot for Hardik. Fired in into the off stump. Pushed to cover
full, middle and leg, he clips it on the walk and gets a single into the leg side
on a length, outside off, punched wide of long-off for two
down the wicket, full and wide again, Saha drives down the ground, Bishnoi gets hand on it, but they get a single
Saha looks to make room but Bishnoi stays tight on the line. Hit straight to cover again
on a length, no room, punched to extra cover
has drawn the shorter delivery by charging out last ball, and Saha cuts it in the air and clears the infield
Saha steps out, Bishnoi goes full and wide for a stumping but Saha gets bat on it, and also0 finds the gap between point and cover-point
looks to charge him, but Avesh remains quick and on a good length. Bunted back to him
short of a length, outside off, punched hard but straight to cover-point
on a length, top off, and Saha drops and runs and makes it before the fielder at point can come in
another pull; from outside off, again he doesn't get all of it, but gets just enough to clear midwicket this time
deliberately played in the air over point. It is the bigger boundary and there is a deep point in place. Gets two for it
not short enough but short-statured Saha manufactures the pull. Doesn't get all of it but gets two to deep midwicket
on a length, on off, slight straightening of the line. Defended
looks to push this down the ground to long-off but can't beat straight extra cover
flatter, on a length, pushed towards extra cover for a quick single
backs away, Krunal pulls the length back, Saha cuts, but can't beat point
shapes up for the sweep early, gets a tope edge but clears short fine
lovely shot. Inside-out to miss the long-off. Makes a bit of room, takes this from middle and leg, and goers over wide mid-off
full and swinging in, clipped past midwicket for one
slower ball, 107ls, on a length. Saha has to check his shot
looks to do that again but this one swings in more, and hits the inside edge of the bat
first boundary of the match. Lovely use of the face of the bat. Short of a length, angling in, and he has taken this from off but guided it between short third and backward point
short of a length, just outside off, punched to deep point
swinging in, runs off the inner half of the bat, and goes square of the boundary rider on the leg side
straightens up the line of off. Defended by Saha
not short enough for the cut, but he goes for it. The top edge falls short and wide of point
similar length, but just outside off. Defended again
on a length, middle and off, defended to mid-off

duck for Gill. Skips out of the crease, seems to me he is looking to hit back over his head, but the turn takes the outer half of the bat for an easy catch to long-off. Early signs all point to a low-scoring match here
fired into the pads, defended to leg
closer to the stumps, and Saha tries to tip and run. Straight to the fielder, though, and is sent back
full and wide, and Saha will feel he has missed out. Tries to drive through the covers but gets just an inside edge
back to good length, defended with an open face
overpitched again, driven straighter this time, but the fielder at cover gets a hand on it to deny them the boundary
wide of the crease, overpitched, driven through cover, but point is back and tidies up
there is the Bumrah-type release beyond the perpendicular. Feels quicker than what is registered on the gun. On a length, swinging in, defended
Mohit beats him with a slower ball. That is a seven-run win after LSG needed just 56 off the last 10

Mohit is not focusing on the non-striker. He nails another yorker, Hooda digs it out to deep midwicket, and goes back for the non-existent second to keep the chances of a tie alive. The throw from the deep is spot on. He is gone. GT win if they don't bowl a no-ball or a wide

good from Mohit. He is not greedy. He knows the batters are expecting the slower ball, which is the wicket-taking delivery. He goes for the yorker, Hooda digs it out, they go for the second, and Badoni is run out. The second is never on

slower short ball. The lethal slower short ball when you are desperate for boundaries. He has to create all the power. Slaps it down the ground but imparts only enough to reach long-on. Mohit is on a hat-trick, and GT are the favourites now

and he has got out after turning an easy equation into a tough one. Slower short ball, into the pitch, cutting in, Rahul pulls, gets a top edge, an d is caught at deep square leg. Rahul looks distraught: 0 off the first 6, 30 off the next 12, 20 off the next 20, 18 off the next 23
Mohit starts with a pace-on yorker, which Rahul manages to dig out, and it goes over Mohit's head. So slow is it hit that they come back for two. Badoni dives in to make the second possible

Rahul guesses right that this is going to be full and wide. Shuffles across for the ramp but misses again. He has not laid bat on ball this entire over. He has faced four balls for one miss and three leg=-byes
not quite the slower ball, bowled at 134ks, short of a length, stays low. Rahul is beaten. He kicks the ground in disgust
down the leg side, but fine leg is fine. Just the single. You will have to consider this a miss from the batter
misses a full toss. He is standing deep in the crease with the front leg cleared to slog over leg side. But he misses the line. Is there some tail there? Another leg-bye
makes room early, Shami stays full and just outside off. Mis-hit to mid-off for one

immediately Rahul looks to use his pace and clears the front leg to go over the leg side. Shami follows him and beats his inside edge. Just the one leg-bye. And they have reviewed it just to waste our time. tactically perhaps it lets them plan for a few seconds more
slower short ball, hit to deep midwicket for one. Six singles in the over
yorker, 134ks, dug out to mid-off for a single
slower ball again, on a length, outside off, cut in front of point for one
slower short ball again, wide outside off, pulled down to long-on
Bluffs him with a yorker. Rahul digs it out for one to long-on
slower short ball, early into the pull, gets a single to long-on
short of a length, down the leg side, Badoni gets enough bat on it to beat short fine and get three as Rashid cleans up behind him

Pooran is under pressure, and he perishes. This game is wide open now. Sees a full ball, looks for the slog sweep, but it turns away to take the toe end. Pandya asks Noor to get out of the way, and completes the catch. Clear calling
on a length, turning away, Pooran looks to cut but can't beat backward point
quick short ball, pulled to deep midwicket for one
misses out. Wide down leg, he gets bat on the paddle sweep, but can't beat short fine
pitched up, pushed to short cover. Another fot
a touch too full, driven down to long-on for one
quick offbreak, can't beat the short straight midwicket as he looks for one to long-on
on a length, into the pads, nudged to leg for one
Pooran tries the reverse sweep, gets a bottom edge through to slip. Getting tense
tossed up, deflected to the right of short midwicket for one
quick offbreak, pushed back to the bowler
tries the sweep this time, is beaten again, but is hit outside the line of off
wrong'un, beats him, hits the pad, but is headed down leg
full, just outside off, driven back at Noor

walks past it. As expected, Pandya is looking to finish it off in a hurry. This time Noor shortens the length, gets enough turn to beat his outside edge as he looks to play this to leg, and Saha does the rest
a touch short, Pandya goes for the cut, but is beaten by the extra bounce
on leg, turns in, helped around the corner for one
quick offbreak, punched to deep midwicket for one more
on a length, on off, defended back to him
down the wicket to chip one again but he has hit it too well. Shankar runs in from long-on, gets it to it with a slide, but can't hold on. What a drop
too full, chipped into the pocket between long-on and deep midwicket for two
too much turn. From a good length it turns to beat his bat, but it is headed down leg
offbreak, slightly short of a length, punched wide of deep cover for two
down the wicket again, this time he is nowhere near the pitch of the ball, so he extends his hands and defends
quicker, on a length, pushed to midwicket
wide down the leg side, he is lucky Krunal has not got some bat on it
wrong'un, around off, defended to off
Krunal with a clean hit. Down the wicket, enough gap between him and the pitch of the ball, and smacks it clean over long-on
legbreak, on a length, pushed to long-on to bring up his fifty off 38 balls. 0 off first 6, 30 off next 12, 20 off next 20
legbreak, on off, pushed to short cover
pushed through, outside off, Krunal beaten as he pushes away from the body
a touch too full, chipped away over midwicket for two. Lovely old-fashioned shot from the ODI middle overs
on a length, turns away, Krunal defends it back
goes back to cut this length ball to deep point for one
wrong'un, stays low too, Rahul pushes it to extra cover
overpitched, on off, pushed to cover
and he bowls the wrong'un now. And it is short enough to let him adjust off the surface. Worked into the leg side for one
on a length, on off, pushed into the leg side for one
too full this time. Doesn't matter which way it turns from that length. Driven to long-off
another legbreak, another not-in-control response. KL is looking for the wrong'un, and is beaten on the outside edge
another legbreak, and he does Rahul in again. This time, though, Rahul gets the outside edge, and Rashid has enough pace to beat short third
legbreak, good length, beats him on the defence
gets the width finally, and expertly places it between backward point and short third. Krunal having the better of his brother today
looking for the big wind-up, but Pandya is quick and on target. Has to defend
length ball outside off, punched to deep cover for one
on-pace, short of a length, cut away, but can't get it past the man at point. Takes the single off the fumble, though
slower offcutter, beats him brother both for pace and the cut off the surface
short of a length, wide, cut away for one
length ball, just outside off, pushed down to long-off for one
full, really full, dug out to the right of Rashid, who gets a hand to it. A lot of yes and no, which ends in turning down of an easy single
pushed into the covers for one

they kept Manohar in and substituted Gill out, and now Manohar has dropped a relatively simple catch. Krunal gets inside the line to sweep but fails to keep it down. Manohar makes a hash of it at long leg
legbreak, beats his inside edge, but is headed down leg
hard sweep. Right in the gap between deep midwicket and long leg. Has timed the pants off it
wrong'un, and Krunal has not picked it. Reacts frantically off the surface and manages to keep it out
orthodox wristspin, Rahul lets it turn and then punches it down to long-on for one
short of a length, hit in the air towards long-on for one
short outside off, cut to deep point for one
wrong'un on a length, pushed into the hole between long-on and deep midwicket for two
long hop to start off with. Too wide too. And he has cut him past extra cover for four
down the wicket too early, Rashid goes outside leg with a wrong'un. In panic, Krunal thrusts his pad at the ball to avoid the stumping
wrong'un now, beaten on the outside edge this time

big appeal for lbw first up. Not given, and they haver reviewed it. Will be tight on where it is pitched. No edge, and looks like it might hit leg, but where it is pitched? It has just pitched outside leg: in that less than 50% of the ball has pitched in line. Lovely legbreak to beat the inside edge, though
Rashid comes back. I think Mayers has played for the wrong'un, but this is a legbreak. He has left a big gap between the bat and the pad for Rashid to bowl him. Rashid is animated i
wrong'un, on a length, punched down to long-on for one
Rashid too short again, pulled to deep square on the bounce
on a length, no room, pushed to straight extra cover
looking for the yorker, clipped away off the pads for one
slower short ball, pulled to deep square for one

beautiful shot. Two lovely shots in two overs, this time from Rahul. Short of a length, no room, and this is merely a defensive push off the back foot. But he has found the gap between mid-off and extra cover. Nobody even moves
slower short ball. So slow it is that Mayers has time to play a second shot. Pulls this for one to deep square leg
short of a length, no room, pushed to point
gets the3 width, goes back to play the back-cut, but can't get it past short third
lovely shot. Shot of the match. Picks the wrong'un, skips down the track, maintains some distance from the pitch of the ball, and goes inside-out with his loft. Way over wide long-off
full, just outside off, defended to cover
wrong'un, on a length, stays back to punch this down the ground
too short again. Horror start for Rashid. Pulled flat over midwicket this time after the square leg pull last ball
too short to start with, and KL is quick to pounce on it. Pulls this over square leg for four
driven away the body, and he places it wide of long-off to be able to come back for two
shimmies down the wicket to push this to long-on for a single
looks to make room, Jayant fires this in on a good length. Manages to squeeze it out for one
down the wicket, gets close to the pitch of the ball, and hits it straight of deep midwicket for four
pitched up, and driven to long-on for another single
on a length, into the pads, pushed to deep midwicket for one
that's 7000 T20 runs for KL Rahul with this hat-trick of fours. Gets some room on the off side this time, and squeezes this past cover-point
first to the right, then to the left.  On a length, old-fashioned swipe into the leg side, and goes off the inner half of the bat to deep midwicket for four
pulled away for his first boundary. A touch too short after the last one was overpitched. Clean shot, and to the right of the boundary rider on the leg side
full, on off, Mayers drives with an open face but doesn't get all of it. Cover-point dives to his right but can't prevent a single
on a length, holds its line on off, pushed to cover-point
walks down the wicket to drive this length ball down to long-on
on a length, on off, Mayers pushes away from the body, but the ball doesn't turn and takes the inside edge to square leg
goes back to good length, tight line, pushed back to him
only slightly short of a length, and he steers it between backward point and short third. Lovely shot to use his pace
full, but middle and leg, pushed to extra cover
on a length, offbreak, pushed down to long-on
chipped towards long-off for one
back-to-back first-over maidens bowled to Rahul. On a length, tight on the off-stump line, defended to mid-off
short of a length, no room, pushed to mid-off
slight nip in from short of a length. Defended by Rahul
slightly short of a length, no room, pushed to mid-on
outswinger, on a length, just outside off, pushed down to mid-off off the outer half of the bat
on a good length, just outside off, defended with an open face
